 select-pane -T titles; capture-pane, which
 copies history for the record; clear-pane,
 for a fresh start; send-keys, for reaching
 into a pane the way you reach to press
 a button in another room — type into a pane
 you are not looking at, command it at distance,
 watch a distant terminal obey you while
 you keep your eyes on metrics somewhere else.
 This is the beginning of automation: sight
 without location, will from anywhere.

 S8:
 Layouts can drift; a day of resizing
 leaves panes like rooms after a party.
 There is even simpler grace in pressing
 prefix space and letting tiled decide
 the fairest division of the current space —
 let the algorithm govern; you have deadlines.
 The five shapes between them cover most
 of what a human wants: one wide and four
 tiled below; a column; a row; a mosaic
 of six cells fit together like a puzzle.

 S9:
 By the second week the chords arrive
 without summoning: hands know the splits,
 the zoom, the census, the rearrangement.
 The window is your workspace, truly yours,
 shaped and reshaped like clay by daily touch.
 Panes are not screens divided into pieces;
 they are attention divided by discipline,
 given walls so each attention may persist

 Operation aborted
